title: session new archives other finished sessions, churning tracked files in an unrelated change (Q3)
symptom: Starting a new session moved nine other tracked sessions it judged done from .chough/sessions/ into .chough/sessions/archive/, byte-identical, so an unrelated change carried tracked-file churn on a shared ledger.
trigger: chough session new <key> --objective ... --intent-scope CI --module github in a fresh worktree from origin/main of a repository whose .chough/sessions/ holds other committed sessions at done or with an archived native change.
expected: Starting or switching work never closes another piece of work: session new and session use touch no other session's files; finished open sessions are listed with their fix, chough doctor --fix (Leif's default Q3, #207, REQ-history-006).
actual: Chough 0.5.0 archived every other finished session as a side effect of session new (spec-sync repository, seen by the spec-sync worker t38b, relayed by the coordinator on 2026-11-11).
steps: In a repository whose .chough/sessions/ holds committed sessions that are done or whose native change is archived, create a fresh worktree from main.
Run chough session new <key> --objective <text> --intent-scope CI --module github.
git status shows those sessions moved from .chough/sessions/ to .chough/sessions/archive/.
impact: Unrelated changes carry moves of other sessions' records, which collide on a shared ledger and blur review; it is the side effect Q3 rules out.
